$comment: Image budgets checked by `npm run assets -- check` (scripts/assets.js), in the CI through scripts/node-checks.js. Each image takes maxImage (bytes) and maxSide (pixels, optional) from the first rule with maxImage whose path matches, and is summed into the group of the first rule with maxTotal. A path ending in / is a directory, * stands for one segment (src/games/*/ = one group per game), '' matches everything. Raise a budget in the same commit as the asset that needs it, with the measured size in the message.
